description: This file contains the implementation of big number division routines for cryptographic operations, including functions for dividing large integers (BIGNUM) and calculating remainders, specific to the OpenSSL cryptography library.

methods.name: int BN_div(BIGNUM * dv,BIGNUM * rm,const BIGNUM * num,const BIGNUM * divisor,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Performs division of large numbers with normalization and long division algorithm, returning quotient and remainder if provided.

methods.name: int BN_mod(BIGNUM * rem,const BIGNUM * m,const BIGNUM * d,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Calculates the remainder of dividing one large number by another, utilizing BN_div internally.
